request.spec:
A hold now has a from-date (default the sheet's today) and an optional to-date, and a person may
have several holds over time. Only a person's OPEN claims dated within a hold are left out of the
live totals; their other open claims count, and a claim bound by a statement stays in the totals
whatever its date. Show hold yes/no as whether the person has any hold. Holding writes
PERSON_HELD name=<name> from=<date>; releasing is no longer a separate action (a hold ends on
its to-date).
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
A hold now has a from-date (default the sheet's today) and an optional to-date, and a person may
have several holds over time. Only a person's OPEN claims dated within a hold are left out of the
live totals; their other open claims count, and a claim bound by a statement stays in the totals
whatever its date. Show hold yes/no as whether the person has any hold. Holding writes
PERSON_HELD name=<name> from=<date>; releasing is no longer a separate action (a hold ends on
its to-date).

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
A person can now have several dated holds, and all 4 acceptance tests pass in `bin/e2e`.

**How holds work now**
- Each hold has a from-date and an optional to-date. A blank from-date means the sheet's today, and a to-date earlier than the from-date is refused with `person-error`. Holds are stored in a new `person_hold` table (migration `V26__person_hold.sql`). Anyone who was on hold before keeps an open-ended hold that has no start date. The old `held` column is dropped.
- Only a person's open (and pending) claims dated within a hold are left out of the totals. Settled claims and claims bound by a statement count whatever their date. This rule is in one place on the server (`Rollup.held`), which the rollup, period totals and statements all use. The front end applies the same rule in `counts()` in `useClaims.ts`, which drives the person, sheet, rate, period and overdue totals.
- `person-hold` shows yes or no for whether the person has any hold. The row also lists every hold (`person-hold-line`) next to the two date fields and the Hold button.
- Holding writes `PERSON_HELD sheet=… by=… name=<name> from=<date>`, followed by the usual ROLLUP/TOTALS lines when the totals change.
- Releasing is gone: `PERSON_RELEASED` is no longer written and the button no longer switches to "Release". A hold ends on its to-date, and there is no way to end or remove an open-ended hold early.

**Not done:** `e2e/support/ui.ts` has a `bulkHold` helper that uses `bulk-hold-*` test ids, but the app has no bulk hold, and this spec doesn't use it. I didn't add one.
